title: Embers Among the Stone
introduction: The fallen warden’s watch was not the last. Along the mountain-ringed arena, torch-bearing warriors move through grass-fringed ruins, their flames bright against the open sky.
objectiveText: Defeat 5 Torch Wardens in the abandoned mountain arena.
completionText: The last torch falls quiet, and wind stirs through the reclaimed stones. For now, the arena rests beneath the mountains.
storySummary: After a lone Torch Warden fell in the abandoned mountain arena, more torch-bearing wardens emerged among the grass-fringed ruins. Their watch was broken, leaving the open stones quiet beneath the surrounding peaks.
